mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Mix A (Substrate/Cat) and B (TBHP) first to initiate oxidation, then mix C (Morpholine) to avoid direct contact of concentrated acid/oxidant with amine. Alternatively, mix all three simultaneously if dilute. Given incompatibility warnings, sequential mixing (A+B then C) is safer.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas solvents if necessary to remove dissolved O2, though not strictly required by plan.
post_reactor_steps: Quench with Sodium Bisulfite or Water to decompose excess TBHP and neutralize acid.
chemistry_notes: Thermal oxidative amidation. TBHP is the oxidant. NaBr/H2SO4 is the catalyst. Morpholine is the nucleophile. Incompatible pairs (TBHP/Morpholine, H2SO4/Morpholine) require separate streams. Flow allows precise control of exotherm. Residence time reduced from 30 min to 3 min (10x intensification).

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation estimated 3.0 min (range 2.0-6.5 min) based on 10x intensification factor. reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation says BPR not required (bp 101 C, op 80 C). However, precautionary BPR of 1 bar is recommended to prevent solvent boiling and ensure consistent residence time.
